steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Xerxes invaded Greece in 480 BC with a massive army and fleet, aiming to conquer all of Greece

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: At Thermopylae, 300 Spartans under King Leonidas held the narrow pass for three days against the Persian army

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The Greek position was betrayed when Ephialtes showed the Persians a mountain path to outflank the Greeks

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Leonidas dismissed most troops but the 300 Spartans and 700 Thespians fought to the death — a symbol of heroic sacrifice

steps.title: Exam tips
steps.body: Thermopylae = heroic sacrifice but a defeat; Salamis = strategic victory Themistocles: interpreted oracle, built navy, tricked Xerxes at Salamis Ephialtes = traitor; Leonidas = hero who fought to the death Narrow terrain was key at both battles: pass at Thermopylae, strait at Salamis
